voice.name: Open Sector - Heavy Assimilator
voice.note: Shares the Heavy Assimilator voice designed for the Stalker (voices/stalker.json): no new custom voice. Slow, brooding delivery. It carries no gun, so its attack lines send the brood instead (a right-click on an enemy still sends cmd.attack).
voice.description: Enormous, slow machine voice of a giant legged alien war machine of a cyborg hive: very deep sub-bass layered voice, as if several huge synthetic voices speak at once an octave apart, grinding metallic overtones and a rumbling engine-like drone beneath every word, cold, emotionless and inevitable, each word heavy and deliberate with long pauses.

birth.prompt: Gross organic alien egg hatching: a wet tearing rip of a fleshy membrane, a thick slimy squelch and gooey splatter, then a small creature's high chittering screech, close, no music, no voice

move.prompt: Huge six-legged alien creature-machine walking slowly: heavy deliberate legs stepping one after another, deep wet squelching thuds into mud, a heavy fleshy sac sloshing and wobbling, low servo groan, close, no music, no voice

die.prompt: Huge alien creature-machine destroyed: a big wet bursting pop of a swollen fleshy egg sac splattering fluid everywhere, a gushing splash, crackling electric arcs, a dying synthetic drone groaning down in pitch and a heavy body collapsing to the ground, medium distance outdoors, no music, no voice
